games.name: Sunplop
games.blurb: A daily logic puzzle: place two suns in every row and column, plus 2,485 more levels.

games.name: Melt
games.blurb: Slide a heat lamp to melt the ice. Meltwater flows downhill and refreezes into bridges that help Puck the seal pup get home.

games.name: Rubber Band Bridge
games.blurb: Stretch elastic bands between pegs to bounce, bridge and snap-launch Pip to the flag, but stretch too far and they snap.

games.name: Ferry Jam
games.blurb: Untangle a packed harbor parking lot and load every car onto the ferry of its color before the dock fills up.

games.name: Fin to Feather
games.blurb: An endless runner where you start as a tiny fish and evolve into a mighty sky bird.

games.name: Lilyward
games.blurb: Guard your frog eggs with a squad of upgradable pond frogs against waves of bugs and the mighty Old Stiltbeak.

games.name: Radar Bite
games.blurb: A free, food-only map of restaurants, takeaways and cafés worldwide, from OpenStreetMap.
